Below is a quick‑start guide for building the **GET** request that pulls interface information from a Cisco Nexus Dashboard (ND) instance. The example uses the **`/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo`** endpoint that you mentioned. --- ## 1. Build the URL | Component | Value | |-----------|-------| | Base URL | `https://192.120.45.67` | | Endpoint | `/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo` | | Query parameters | `fabricName=Network1`
`nodeId=12`
`podId=10`
`interfaceType=ethernet`
`infoType=Speed` | **Full URL** ``` https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo?fabricName=Network1&nodeId=12&podId=10&interfaceType=ethernet&infoType=Speed ``` > **Note** > * `interfaceType` is case‑sensitive – use the lowercase value `"ethernet"` as shown. > * `infoType` accepts `"Speed"` with a capital “S” (per the API spec). --- ## 2. Authentication ND APIs are usually protected with a bearer token (or basic auth). Add the token to the request header: ``` Authorization: Bearer ``` If you’re using a self‑signed certificate, you’ll also need to skip verification (`-k` in curl or `verify=False` in Python). --- ## 3. Example Requests ### a) `curl` ```bash curl -k \ -X GET "https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo?fabricName=Network1&nodeId=12&podId=10&interfaceType=ethernet&infoType=Speed" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer " ``` ### b) Python (`requests`) ```python import requests url = "https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo" params = { "fabricName": "Network1", "nodeId": 12, "podId": 10, "interfaceType": "ethernet", "infoType": "Speed" } headers = { "Authorization": "Bearer " } response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers=headers, verify=False) print(response.status_code) print(response.json()) ``` --- ## 4. Using the Tool (Optional) If you want to invoke the request directly from this chat (via the provided `functions.requests_get`), you can do: ```json { "url": "https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo", "params": { "fabricName": "Network1", "nodeId": 12, "podId": 10, "interfaceType": "ethernet", "infoType": "Speed" } } ``` (You would still need to supply the bearer token in the request header; the tool does not handle auth.) --- ## 5. Quick Checklist | ✅ | Item | |----|------| | ✅ | Base URL + endpoint correct | | ✅ | Query parameters match the API spec | | ✅ | `interfaceType` = `"ethernet"` | | ✅ | `infoType` = `"Speed"` | | ✅ | Bearer token added to `Authorization` header | | ✅ | SSL verification handled (`-k` / `verify=False`) if needed | That’s all you need to generate a RESTful API request for the “get information of an interface” operation on Cisco Nexus Dashboard 6.3.1. Happy querying!
